decisions.reason: As a low-cost extension of the established infrared heating platform, it still has option value in a growing market and is worth keeping unless demand proves clearly weak.
Its own product page suggests meaningful commercial commitment, and as a close fit with the firm's core offer it is likely cheaper to retain than to abandon.
This product is somewhat more exposed to overlap and uncertain demand than the main lines, but the firm's narrow portfolio and the low incremental cost of keeping it support continuation.
Because it is a full product line with several models in a core application area, it offers strong strategic coverage and high option value, so dropping it soon is unlikely.
A standard plaque heater broadens coverage of customer needs within the firm's core business, and the evidence suggests enough commitment to justify keeping it on the market.

Its overlap with another tube-heater line raises rationalization risk, but in this specialized machinery business the firm would still likely keep the option open for another year before withdrawing it.
